messages.content: What's the name of a type of cell that has multiple nuclei?

function.name: bloodcell_classification
function.description: Identify and categorize different types of blood cells based on given attributes. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

cell_shape.description: The shape of the cell, e.g. round, oval.

cell_size.description: The size of the cell, e.g. large, medium, small.

cell_function.description: The function of the cell, e.g. carrying oxygen, fighting infection. Default: 'carry oxygen'.

message.content:
A common example of a multinucleated cell is a **skeletal‑muscle fiber** (also called a myocyte).  
These cells fuse during development into long strands that contain dozens—sometimes hundreds—of nuclei distributed along their length.  

Other examples include:

| Cell Type | Typical Function |
|-----------|------------------|
| Osteoclast | Bone resorption; formed from fusion of mononuclear precursors |
| Syncytiotrophoblast | Part of the placenta; facilitates nutrient exchange between mother and fetus |
| Myxoma cells | Tumor cells that may become multinucleated |

So if you’re looking for a “name” rather than an attribute list, *skeletal‑muscle fiber* is one of the most well‑known multinucleated cells.
